verdict.rationale: Google documents an Agent SDK (Python) exposing the same agent loop, tools, and context management as the product, plus a documented CLI with slash-commands/config for scripting agent workflows — both count as a public, documented programmatic interface. However, there is no formal REST/OpenAPI-style public API (probe explicitly found all OpenAPI/swagger endpoints 404), and no independent/community evidence corroborates hands-on use of the SDK itself. missing for 10: a REST/OpenAPI-documented API, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
